Title: Sr. Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWS Industries
Description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The AWS Professional Services (ProServe) Telco, Media & Entertainment, Gaming and Sports (TMEGS) Delivery Practice is seeking a Sr. Engagement Manager (EM) to own the delivery of complex, outcome-based cloud and AI programs for our customers. In this role you are accountable for business outcomes, not just project milestones. You will help shape what we commit to, negotiate it with customer executives, and deliver it profitably.  
  
Most of our engagements are delivered on a fixed-price, outcome-based model. You will turn customer ambitions into measurable outcomes, clear acceptance criteria and a milestone plan that both the customer and AWS can stand behind. You will work with sales and solution architects before signature to make sure what we sell is deliverable. After signature, you will manage scope, change and commercial performance with discipline: tracking earned value, protecting margin, and negotiating trade-offs with customer executives when priorities shift. You are comfortable having difficult conversations early, and you know how to protect both the customer relationship and the commercial position.  
  
You will lead delivery teams that use AI throughout the delivery lifecycle, from requirements and design through code generation, testing and operations, to deliver outcomes faster and at higher quality than traditional approaches. You are hands-on with AI-assisted delivery tools, and fluent enough in architecture and engineering to challenge AI-generated plans and designs, make informed trade-offs on performance, security, scalability and cost, and keep quality high as delivery speed increases. You apply AWS frameworks such as Well-Architected and the Cloud Adoption Framework, and you build automated quality gates so standards hold as delivery scales.  
  
Our largest programs combine AWS builders with AWS Partner Network (APN) partners and sometimes customer-selected system integrators. You will orchestrate this mixed workforce to a single quality bar. That means setting clear accountability, consistent acceptance criteria and mechanisms that make standards hold by design rather than by inspection. You will also drive change management on the customer side, so the organization adopts what we build and the business value is realized.  
  
You will build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders up to C-level, report progress in terms of business value delivered, and spot leading indicators of risk such as velocity, environment stability, partner quality and team health, acting on them before they become escalations. As you grow, you will lead larger multi-workstream programs, help shape how we price and measure outcomes, and contribute reusable assets, patterns and AI-enabled practices that make the next engagement faster than the last. You are expected to achieve and maintain relevant AWS certifications, including in AI, and to develop deep domain expertise.  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud and AI initiatives. We provide a collection of offerings that help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption, and focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies and industries.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Owning delivery of complex, outcome-based cloud and AI programs end to end, accountable for customer business outcomes, delivery quality and commercial performance
* Working with sales and solution architects before signature to shape scope, define measurable outcomes and acceptance criteria, and confirm what we commit to is deliverable
* Negotiating scope, milestones and trade-offs with customer executives, and managing fixed-price engagements through disciplined change control, earned-value tracking and margin protection
* Managing engagement revenue and financial health: forecasting revenue against milestones, maintaining an accurate estimate at completion, driving timely milestone acceptance and billing, and identifying expansion opportunities that grow the customer relationship
* Leading delivery teams that use AI across the lifecycle (requirements, design, code generation, testing and operations), and applying enough technical depth to challenge AI-generated output and make informed trade-offs on security, performance, scalability and cost
* Orchestrating mixed teams of AWS builders, AWS Partner Network partners and customer-selected integrators to a single quality bar, with clear accountability, consistent acceptance criteria and automated quality gates
* Driving customer-side change management and adoption, so the organization realizes the value of what we build
* Reporting progress to senior stakeholders in terms of business value delivered, and acting on leading indicators of risk (velocity, environment stability, partner quality, team health) before they become escalations
* Contributing reusable assets, patterns and AI-enabled delivery practices that make each engagement faster and more repeatable than the last

Description:
Our Technology team wakes up every day with one goal in mind - connecting Canadians to the people and things that matter most. **Who we're looking for:**

The Public Cloud Operations Lead is a hands-on technical leadership role responsible for supporting and leading Public Cloud operations and Site Reliability Engineering (CloudSRE).

  

This is not a coordination-only role. The successful candidate is expected to remain actively involved in cloud troubleshooting, incident investigation, automation, observability, and technical problem solving while providing day-to-day technical leadership to the CloudSRE team and oversight of managed service providers.

The ideal candidate has a minimum of 4 years of relevant cloud, SRE, or infrastructure operations experience, previous experience as a Team Lead, Technical Lead, or equivalent, and strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Azure and AWS. Experience with GCP and OCI is considered an asset.

**What you'll do:**

Technical Leadership

* Provide hands-on technical leadership to the CloudSRE team, remaining actively engaged in engineering, operational activities, and complex troubleshooting.
* Act as the senior technical escalation point for cloud infrastructure, reliability, performance, availability, and major operational issues, leading root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
Establish engineering standards and technical guardrails while mentoring engineers and strengthening the overall technical capability of the CloudSRE team.  

Public Cloud Operations

* Provide hands-on administration, operations, and troubleshooting across Microsoft Azure and AWS, with experience in GCP and/or OCI considered an asset.

Drive improvements in reliability, security, performance, operational efficiency, and cost, while supporting incident, problem, change, capacity, and availability management.  

SRE & Observability

* Drive proactive monitoring and observability across infrastructure, platform, and application services using logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, alerting, and service-health telemetry.

Improve alert quality, reduce noise, and use operational telemetry to proactively identify reliability, performance, capacity, and service-health risks, leveraging platforms such as Dynatrace, Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk, or equivalent.  

Automation & Engineering

* Identify repetitive operational activities and automate them to reduce manual effort, operational risk, and human error using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar technologies.

Promote an engineering-first approach to cloud operations, driving continuous improvement through automation, standardization, and reusable engineering solutions.  

AI & AIOps

* Drive the practical adoption of AI-assisted operations and AIOps within the CloudSRE team, incorporating AI into day-to-day operational and engineering workflows.
* Apply AI-assisted capabilities to troubleshooting, incident investigation, log analysis, operational analysis, automation, and documentation to accelerate problem resolution.
Identify and implement opportunities where AI agents, AI-assisted engineering tools, and AIOps platforms can reduce manual effort, improve operational efficiency, and enhance service reliability.  

Incident & Problem Management

* Provide technical leadership during high-severity Public Cloud incidents, coordinating troubleshooting across CloudSRE, application teams, Cyber, infrastructure teams, vendors, and cloud service providers.

Improve MTTD and MTTR through better observability, automation, runbooks, operational practices, and proactive problem management.  

Vendor Management

* Review vendor performance including technical deliverables, incident response, SLA adherence, engineering quality, and compliance with established cloud operational standards.
Identify and address vendor capability or performance gaps, challenging technical solutions where appropriate and driving vendors toward sustainable engineering solutions and corrective actions.  

Collaboration & Communication

* Collaborate closely with application teams, infrastructure, Cyber, engineering, service management, vendors, and cloud service providers to deliver reliable Public Cloud services.
* Translate complex technical issues into clear, actionable information for technical, non-technical, and leadership stakeholders, including risks, dependencies, and improvement opportunities.

  **.**

  levels

* Develop, scale, and deploy custom automations using Dynamo for Civil 3D/Revit, Python, or VBA to eliminate repetitive drafting tasks, automate grading calculations, and auto-populate asset metadata fields.
* Implement AI-driven design tools and generative design algorithms for optimizing massive earthworks volumes, alternative highway corridor alignments, and automated clash resolution pipelines.
* Utilize AI text and data analytics tools to run predictive automated audits on thousands of model parameters, catching quality drops instantly.

+ Roads & Highways
+ Rail & Transit
+ Bridges and Structures
+ Utilities
+ Aviation
+ Smart Infrastructure Projects

* Demonstrated success in implementing BIM and digital transformation strategies within engineering consultancies.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary digital delivery teams.

Title: Senior Incident Responder
Description:

* Coordinate incident communications with customers, vendors and internal stakeholders.
* Maintain evidence handling and chain-of-custody standards.
* Run post-incident reviews and produce incident reports with root cause and corrective actions.
* Plan and run tabletop exercises, and maintain incident response readiness (tools, access and contacts).
* Support regulatory, contractual and audit requirements, including incident notification.
* Mentor and coach SOC analysts in investigation and response techniques.
* Deliver training and maintain the incident response knowledge base.
* Promote a culture of accountability, calm execution and continuous improvement.
* Foster collaboration between SOC, engineering, infrastructure and customer-facing teams.
* Brief customers and executives during and after major incidents.
* Participate in customer service reviews, and support incident response retainer and service offerings.
* Support pre-sales discussions on incident response capabilities.
* Provide executive-level reporting on incidents, trends and improvement actions.
* Contribute to the growth and enhancement of MSSP incident response services.

**Qualifications and Job Specific skills:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Science, or related field.
* Minimum 10+ years of cybersecurity experience with at least 5 years in incident response or digital forensics roles.
* Certifications such as GCIH, GCFA, GCFR, GNFA or ECIH preferred.
* Hands-on experience with EDR/XDR, SIEM, SOAR and forensic tools (e.g., Velociraptor, KAPE, Volatility).
* Experience responding to incidents in enterprise, cloud (Azure, AWS, Microsoft 365) and multi-tenant MSSP environments.
* Strong understanding of attacker techniques, ransomware operations and threat actor behavior.
* Excellent communication and decision-making skills under pressure.
* Certifications such as GCIH, GCFA, GCFR, GNFA or ECIH preferred.

The Manager of Network Infrastructure Engineering and Operations is responsible for the day-to-day tactical execution, service delivery, and operational health of the Nexus organization. This role explicitly focuses on "Run the Business" activities, overseeing incident management, contractor performance, and routine deployments. By taking full ownership of operations and daily delivery, this role ensures strict adherence to enterprise SLAs and seamlessly transitions newly designed architectures from the Director's strategic engineering team into steady-state operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Operations & Daily Service Delivery: Own the day-to-day operational core of the enterprise network infrastructure. Ensure high availability, performance, and security across all corporate and data center environments, focusing strictly on tactical execution and continuous service delivery.
* Incident & Problem Management: Serve as the primary operational commander for critical network incidents. Drive root cause analysis (RCA), ensure rapid service restoration, and implement preventative operational measures to mitigate future outages.

**Qualifications**

* Operational Networking: Deep technical understanding of enterprise routing, switching, and data center infrastructure operations (BGP, OSPF, VxLAN) for troubleshooting and steady-state maintenance.
* Network Security & Edge Operations: Strong operational familiarity with managing and maintaining enterprise firewalls (Check Point, Fortinet), load balancing architectures (F5 BIG-IP / rSeries), and Zero Trust Network Access (Zscaler ZTNA).
* Wireless Delivery: Experience operating, maintaining, and troubleshooting modern enterprise wireless networks (Juniper MIST).
* Identity & Access: Operational experience maintaining enterprise device management and access control (Cisco ISE, TACACS+).
* Operational Automation: Familiarity with leveraging infrastructure-as-code (IaC) and automation pipelines (Terraform, Spacelift) for routine operational tasks and firewall change automation.
* Leadership Skills: Proven ability to manage high-pressure incident bridges, prioritize competing daily operational demands, and drive tactical execution metrics.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing geographically distributed operational teams across multiple corporate sites.
* Experience maintaining physical data center audits and integrating operational asset tracking into DCIM/CMDB platforms (Device42).

Title: Incident Manager
Description:
Koniag IT Systems, LLC a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking an Incident Manager to support KITS and our government customer Washington, DC. The position is hybrid, requires 3 days onsite. This position requires the candidate to be able to obtain a Public Trust.
  
Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement.
  
Koniag IT Systems, a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking an experienced Incident Manager to support a comprehensive enterprise IT operations and support engagement for a federal customer. This role serves as the primary owner of the enterprise incident management lifecycle, ensuring rapid detection, triage, escalation, resolution, and post-incident review of IT incidents across a geographically distributed, 24x7 hybrid on-premises and cloud environment spanning AWS commercial and GovCloud, Microsoft 365, Azure Government, and enterprise network and application platforms.
  
  
The Incident Manager operates within a mature ITIL 4-aligned IT Service Management (ITSM) practice and works in close coordination with the enterprise NOC, multi-tier Service Desk, network engineering, infrastructure, and platform operations teams to ensure that all incidents are managed to resolution within established service level objectives. This individual plays a central role in driving service restoration, minimizing business impact, and contributing to the program's continual service improvement objectives through trend analysis, problem identification, and post-incident learning activities.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented and operationally experienced ITSM professional with a strong background in enterprise incident management, ITIL-based service management practices, and federal IT operations environments. This individual must thrive in a fast-paced, high-accountability 24x7 operational setting and possess the ability to coordinate effectively across diverse technical teams and Government stakeholders under time-critical conditions.
  
This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain an SBA background investigation, HSPD-12 PIV credentials, and applicable IT access authorizations prior to performing work. This position may be primarily performed at SBA Headquarters and/or approved remote/telework locations.
  
  
The Incident Manager is responsible for owning and managing the end-to-end enterprise incident management lifecycle in accordance with ITIL 4 best practices and SBA OCIO service management requirements. This individual ensures that all incidents—from Tier 1 Service Desk tickets through Priority 1 critical enterprise outages—are accurately classified, prioritized, assigned, escalated, and resolved within established service level agreements (SLAs). The Incident Manager serves as the central coordination hub during major incidents, driving technical bridge calls, managing stakeholder communications, and ensuring timely service restoration. This role also contributes to problem management, change management support, knowledge management, and continual service improvement activities.
  
  
Principal responsibilities will include but are not limited to:
  
  
**Incident Lifecycle Management:**  

* Own and manage the full enterprise incident management lifecycle from initial detection and logging through triage, categorization, prioritization, assignment, escalation, resolution, and formal closure in the Government's ITSM platform.
* Ensure all incidents are accurately classified by priority (P1–P4) in accordance with established impact and urgency criteria, and that appropriate response and resolution timelines are applied and monitored in real time.
* Monitor the active incident queue continuously, identifying aging incidents, escalation triggers, SLA breach risks, and stalled assignments, and taking proactive action to ensure forward progress on all open incidents.
* Coordinate and drive the timely assignment of incidents to the appropriate Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3, or Tier 4 technical resources based on incident category, complexity, and required expertise.
* Ensure incidents are escalated promptly and appropriately—both functionally across technical teams and hierarchically to program leadership and Government stakeholders—when SLA thresholds, scope, or business impact warrant escalation.
* Maintain accurate, complete, and timely incident records in the ITSM platform throughout the incident lifecycle, ensuring all actions, decisions, workarounds, and resolutions are thoroughly documented.

**Major Incident Management:**  

* Serve as the primary coordinator and decision-maker for all Priority 1 (P1) and Priority 2 (P2) major incidents, activating and leading technical bridge calls, war rooms, and cross-functional response teams to drive rapid service restoration.
* Ensure P1 critical incidents are acknowledged within 15 minutes and that service restoration is achieved within 4 hours in accordance with program service level objectives, meeting the Government's target of at least 90% of P1 incidents restored within the 4-hour SLA.
* Maintain clear, accurate, and timely stakeholder communications throughout major incident events, including initial notifications, status updates at defined intervals, and formal incident closure notifications to the COR and Government stakeholders.
* Coordinate with the NOC, Service Desk Manager, technical leads, and program leadership to ensure all required resources are engaged, barriers to resolution are removed, and escalation paths are followed during major incidents.
* Lead or facilitate formal post-incident reviews (PIRs) for all P1 and significant P2 incidents, ensuring root cause analysis findings, contributing factors, corrective actions, and lessons learned are thoroughly documented and tracked to completion.

**Problem Management Coordination:**  

* Collaborate with the Problem Manager or Service Management Lead to ensure incidents exhibiting patterns of recurrence or systemic root causes are formally transitioned into the problem management process.
* Contribute incident trend data, recurring issue patterns, and workaround documentation to support problem record creation, root cause investigation, and known error documentation.
* Track and monitor the implementation of permanent fixes and corrective actions arising from problem management activities, ensuring incident recurrence rates are measurably reduced over time.

**Change Management Support:**  

* Coordinate with the change management process to identify incidents resulting from unauthorized changes or failed changes, ensuring accurate linkage between incident records and associated change records in the ITSM platform.
* Participate in Change Advisory Board (CAB) activities as needed, providing incident trend data and operational risk inputs to support change impact assessment and scheduling decisions.

**ITSM Platform Administration & Reporting:**  

* Administer and maintain incident management workflows, categorization schemas, assignment group structures, escalation rules, and SLA configurations within the Government's ITSM platform (ServiceNow or equivalent) to ensure accurate and efficient incident processing.
* Develop, maintain, and deliver recurring incident management performance reports and dashboards, including metrics on incident volumes, SLA compliance rates, mean time to acknowledge (MTTA), mean time to resolve (MTTR), first-contact resolution rates, escalation rates, and incident trends by category and priority.
* Contribute incident management metrics and performance data to Sprint Review Reports, Monthly Status and Performance Reports, and the service-level/ITSM metrics dashboard submitted to the Government by the 5th business day of each month.
* Analyze incident data to identify trends, high-volume categories, recurring issues, and improvement opportunities, providing actionable recommendations to program leadership and the Service Management Lead.

**Knowledge Management:**  

* Oversee the development, review, and maintenance of incident-related knowledge base articles, resolution guides, troubleshooting procedures, and known error workarounds in the Government's ITSM knowledge management system.
* Ensure Tier 1 and Tier 2 Service Desk personnel have access to current, accurate, and actionable knowledge base content to support first-contact resolution objectives, targeting at least 70% of eligible tickets resolved at Tier 1.
* Promote a knowledge-sharing culture across the NOC and Service Desk, ensuring resolution documentation is captured at ticket closure and that institutional knowledge is preserved throughout personnel transitions.

**Agile Delivery Integration:**  

* Participate in Sprint ceremonies as required, including Sprint Planning, backlog refinement, and Sprint Retrospectives, contributing incident management workstream priorities, improvement backlog items, and operational performance data to the Sprint cadence.
* Maintain and manage incident management-related backlog items in the Government's Agile/ITSM tooling, ensuring items are accurately prioritized, estimated, and tracked to completion each Sprint.
* Identify and propose process improvement opportunities for inclusion in the program backlog, driving measurable enhancements to incident management efficiency, SLA performance, and customer satisfaction.

**Security & Compliance:**  

* Ensure all incident management activities comply with applicable Federal security, privacy, and compliance requirements, including FISMA, NIST SP 800-53, SBA IT and cybersecurity policies, and CUI safeguarding requirements.
* Ensure suspected or confirmed security incidents are promptly identified, escalated, and reported in accordance with SBA incident response procedures and applicable Federal reporting requirements.
* Support the application of least-privilege, separation-of-duties, and Zero Trust principles within incident management workflows and access control practices.

**Education and Experience:****Required:**  

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field from an accredited college or university. Equivalent work experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in IT service management, with at least 3 years of dedicated experience in an Incident Manager, Major Incident Manager, or equivalent ITSM leadership role in an enterprise federal IT environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing the full incident lifecycle—including P1 major incident coordination—in a 24x7 enterprise IT operations environment of comparable scale and complexity.
* Demonstrated experience with ITIL-based ITSM practices, including incident management, problem management, change management, and knowledge management.
* Hands-on experience administering and managing incidents within an enterprise ITSM platform, preferably ServiceNow.
* Ability to obtain and maintain an SBA background investigation, HSPD-12 PIV credentials, and all required IT access authorizations prior to performing work requiring such access.

**Preferred:**  

* Prior experience supporting federal civilian agency IT operations programs.
* Experience supporting incident management within hybrid on-premises and cloud environments, including AWS and Microsoft Azure/365.
* Experience working within an Agile IT operations delivery model, integrating ITSM processes with Sprint-based planning and prioritization.

**Required Skills and Competencies:**  

* Exceptional communication skills in English—both written and oral—with the demonstrated ability to communicate clearly and concisely under time-critical conditions to diverse audiences including technical teams, program leadership, and senior Government stakeholders.
* Proven ability to lead and coordinate cross-functional technical teams during high-pressure major incident events, driving rapid diagnosis and service restoration without direct authority over all participants.
* Deep knowledge of ITIL 4 incident management principles and practices, including incident classification, prioritization, escalation, SLA management, major incident management, and post-incident review processes.
* Hands-on proficiency with enterprise ITSM platforms, particularly ServiceNow, including incident workflow configuration, queue management, SLA monitoring, escalation rule management, and reporting.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify incident trends, recurring patterns, and systemic issues from ITSM data and translate findings into actionable improvement recommendations.
* Experience developing and maintaining incident management performance dashboards and metrics reports, including MTTA, MTTR, SLA compliance rates, first-contact resolution rates, and incident volume trends.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain a high-quality knowledge base, ensuring Tier 1 and Tier 2 Service Desk personnel have access to current, accurate resolution guidance.
* Strong understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure components relevant to incident management, including network, server, cloud (AWS/Azure), Microsoft 365, and enterprise application platforms.
* Familiarity with federal IT security and compliance requirements, including FISMA, NIST SP 800-53, Zero Trust Architecture principles, and CUI safeguarding requirements.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to simultaneously manage multiple open incidents at varying priority levels, maintaining accurate records and ensuring no incident falls through the cracks.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Microsoft Teams, and enterprise collaboration tools.

**Desired Skills and Competencies:**  

* ITIL 4 Foundation certification or higher (e.g., ITIL 4 Specialist: High Velocity IT, ITIL 4 Managing Professional).
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) or ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) – IT Service Management.
* Experience managing incidents within AWS commercial and/or GovCloud environments, including familiarity with AWS monitoring, alerting, and event management tooling.
* Experience managing Microsoft 365 and Azure Government-related incidents, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, and Microsoft Entra identity incidents.
* Familiarity with enterprise network incident management, including LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, routing, switching, wireless, and network security fabric incidents.
* Experience with enterprise monitoring and event management platforms (e.g., SolarWinds, Splunk, Dynatrace, or equivalent) as they relate to automated incident detection and correlation.
* Knowledge of problem management and root cause analysis methodologies, including Fishbone/Ishikawa analysis, 5 Whys, and Kepner-Tregoe problem analysis.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies and experience participating in Sprint ceremonies within an IT operations context.
* Experience supporting post-incident review (PIR) facilitation and corrective action tracking programs in a federal IT environment.
* CompTIA Security+, CISSP, or equivalent cybersecurity certification demonstrating knowledge appropriate to managing incidents involving Federal IT systems and sensitive data.
* Experience with HSPD-12/PIV credentialing processes and federal identity and access management platforms, including Okta and Microsoft Entra.
* Familiarity with Section 508 compliance requirements as they apply to ITSM reporting tools and knowledge management platforms.
* Experience contributing to continual service improvement programs within an ITIL-aligned, Agile IT operations environment.

- Automation Engineering: Design and build automated workflows to streamline incident response, such as automated stakeholder communications, auto-remediation scripts, and tool integrations.
  
- Oncall Support: The Incident Management team operates 24x5x365 with on-call rotation during weekends. This position is for the Sunday to Thursday shift, from 5 PM PT to 2 AM PT.

- Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a track record of translating deeply technical issues into clear business impact summaries for leadership.
  
- Strong working knowledge of ITIL incident management frameworks or modern DevOps/SRE incident response practices.

- Deep alignment with Google SRE principles, including Error Budgets, SLA/SLO/SLI management, and automation-first mindsets.

Title: Head of Infrastructure and Cybersecurity
Description:
**DT One | Dubai | Full-time**
**About Us**
DT One operates a leading global network for mobile top-up, digital value products and rewards. Through a single API connection, we link more than 2,800 partners, including mobile operators, money transfer operators, e-wallets, super apps and retail networks, across 190 countries. Our partners can offer over 23,000 products, from airtime and data top-ups to gift cards and bill payments. We have processed more than 1.2 billion transactions and reach a potential audience of over five billion people, helping to ensure that no one is left unconnected.
  
  
Founded in 2005 and part of the Thunes group, DT One is headquartered in Singapore with regional offices in Dubai, Miami, Nairobi, London and Barcelona.
  
  
For more information visit www.dtone.com
  
  
**Context of the role**
We're looking for a Head of Infrastructure and Cybersecurity who is passionate about protecting platforms that move money and value in real time, and who wants to shape how security and infrastructure are run across a fast-growing, global business. As part of the Technology leadership team, you will own the security strategy, reference architecture and roadmap for DT One, and lead the team that builds and runs our infrastructure and security controls day to day.
  
  
You will combine a startup mindset with the scale of an industry leader. Our platform processes millions of transactions every month, connects thousands of partners across 190 countries and runs 24/7 on AWS. That means our infrastructure must be resilient, our identities and privileged access tightly governed, our edge protected, and our security operations able to detect and respond quickly, while meeting the expectations of payment schemes, regulators, auditors and investors in every market we operate in.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set direction with the senior leadership team and act as design authority for new platforms, while staying close enough to the engineering to lead major programmes yourself, such as zero-trust access, SIEM modernisation and security as code.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
We're looking for a highly driven, technically excellent security and infrastructure leader who is truly excited about having a meaningful impact within the company. In this role, you will own how DT One's infrastructure is designed, secured and operated, from the network edge and cloud landing zone through to identity, endpoints and the security operations centre.
  
  

* Define and own the security strategy, reference architectures and multi-year roadmap, working with senior leadership; run security assessments and gap analyses across the business to prioritise the controls that matter most
* Act as security design authority, reviewing and approving the architecture of new products, platforms and partner integrations so that security is designed in from the start
* Own the cloud and infrastructure security posture on AWS (and any multi-cloud footprint), including landing zone design, guardrails, CSPM, CIS hardening and security Infrastructure as Code in Terraform
* Lead network and edge security, including WAF, DDoS protection, DNS, next-generation firewalls, micro-segmentation and network access control, and drive the move to zero-trust network access in place of legacy VPN
* Own identity and access management: identity architecture, SSO (SAML, OIDC), MFA and passwordless, Conditional Access, privileged access management, identity governance and automated joiner-mover-leaver processes
* Lead security operations and the SOC, including SIEM strategy and migration, log source onboarding, detection engineering aligned to MITRE ATT&CK, ingestion cost optimisation, audit logging and incident response
* Run endpoint and vulnerability management across the estate, including EDR, MDM/MAM, patching, vulnerability scanning, penetration testing and remediation with engineering teams
* Lead PCI-DSS compliance and recertification, and align our controls to ISO 27001, NIST CSF and CIS Controls
* Lead the security workstream for audits, partner assessments, M&A and investor due diligence, and maintain clear security architecture documentation for executives, auditors and the Board
* Set governance for the safe use of AI and generative-AI services across the business, including technical controls on unapproved tools
* Own the infrastructure and security budget: build business cases for new controls and technologies, lead vendor selection and proofs of concept, and manage a multi-vendor environment
* Build, lead and develop a team across infrastructure security, IAM, security operations and SOC, including hiring, performance management and career development

**What we are looking for**

* 15+ years' experience across infrastructure, networking and cybersecurity, including at least 5 years leading security architecture, engineering or operations teams
* Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience
* Experience in payments or fintech
* Proven track record of setting security strategy and reference architectures with a CISO or CTO, and acting as design authority for new platforms
* Track record of building infrastructure and security functions from the ground up, including standing up the full IT, network and security stack for a new business at pace
* Deep hands-on expertise in network and edge security (for example Cloudflare, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Cisco), with a strong routing, switching and core network foundation
* Hands-on cloud security experience on AWS, Azure and/or GCP, including landing zones, CSPM and security Infrastructure as Code with Terraform
* Experience delivering zero-trust network access programmes (for example Zscaler ZPA) at scale
* Strong identity and privileged access experience, for example Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, PIM, PAM platforms such as One Identity Safeguard, and IGA platforms such as Saviynt
* Experience leading SOC teams and SIEM platforms (for example Microsoft Sentinel, KQL, IBM QRadar), including platform migrations and log ingestion cost optimisation
* Experience leading PCI-DSS certification and maintaining compliance through annual recertification
* Working knowledge of CIS Controls, MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF and ISO 27001
* Experience owning budgets, running vendor selection and explaining risk and trade-offs clearly to senior business leaders, auditors and investors
* Expert-level professional certification such as CCIE, CISSP or equivalent; CEH or vendor security certifications are a plus
* Comfortable using AI-assisted engineering to deliver faster, and interested in the security of AI services
* Fluent Arabic and English, spoken and written (essential)
* Interest in the Fintech industry and market innovations

We can offer you an environment with a culture of learning and feedback. You will have real ownership of the security and infrastructure of a platform that is used 24/7 around the world and needs to be reliable, secure and massively scalable. You will work with technology teams in different countries, and our environment and packages match the ambition of the company: building world-class engineering teams.
  
  
**Sound like you? Apply now!**

Title: Oracle Service Delivery Manager
Description:
**About Centroid**
Centroid helps organizations modernize, operate, and support mission-critical business systems across Oracle and multi-cloud environments. We provide advisory, deployment, migration, integration, and managed services, with a focus on strong client service, dependable delivery, and career growth for our employees.
  
  
Travel: up to 10%
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
Centroid is seeking a Service Delivery Manager (SDM) to lead assigned Cloud Managed Services accounts. This role is responsible for client satisfaction, service quality, account health, financial performance, and responsible growth. The SDM serves as the primary service management contact for clients and works closely with technical teams, leadership, and internal stakeholders to keep delivery aligned with scope, service commitments, and client expectations.
  
  
This is a client-facing delivery leadership role, not a hands-on technical administration role. The ideal candidate is organized, accountable, comfortable working through matrixed global teams, and able to manage priorities, risks, escalations, and follow-through in a fast-paced managed services environment.
  
  
What We’re Looking For
  
  
Success in this role requires more than experience. We are looking for candidates who can share real examples that demonstrate the following traits:
  
  

* Flexibility: Adapts quickly when priorities, client needs, or delivery constraints change.
* Process-driven and organized: Uses structure, follow-up routines, and clear communication to keep work moving.
* Intrinsically motivated: Takes initiative, follows through, and looks for ways to improve outcomes.
* Interested in learning and growing: Is coachable, curious, and open to learning Centroid’s way of working.
* Accountable: Owns commitments, raises risks early, and closes the loop with clients and internal teams.

Key Responsibilities
  
  
Client Leadership and Account Health
  
  

* Lead the overall health of assigned Cloud Managed Services accounts, including client satisfaction, retention, service quality, profitability, and responsible growth.
* Run the regular client and internal cadence, including monthly reviews, QBRs, risk reviews, decision tracking, and follow-up actions.
* Communicate performance, risks, recommendations, and improvement opportunities clearly to client and Centroid leadership.

Service Delivery and Governance
  
  

* Oversee service delivery across assigned accounts, technologies, and global teams while staying within SOWs, SLAs, procedures, and Centroid standards.
* Set up practical account governance, including meeting cadence, reporting, escalation paths, roles, responsibilities, and decision processes.
* Coordinate with technical, service desk, security, consulting, vendor, and leadership teams to keep work moving and handoffs clear.

Service Operations, Transitions, and Escalations
  
  

* Lead coordination and client communication during incidents, escalations, outages, maintenance windows, production changes, and other high-priority situations.
* Keep ownership clear, drive the communication rhythm, confirm recovery, and make sure RCA and corrective actions are completed.
* Support transitions into Cloud Managed Services by confirming scope, SLAs, resources, access, documentation, knowledge transfer, monitoring, ticket routing, and readiness.

Financial Management
  
  

* Manage account financial health, including budget, revenue, margin, utilization, forecasting, billing readiness, and financial risk.
* Watch demand and scope, identify out-of-scope work early, and support change orders, renewals, profitability improvements, and account planning.

Resource Leadership
  
  

* Lead onshore and offshore delivery teams supporting 24x7 operations while partnering with technical managers who own direct people management.
* Plan for capacity, identify coverage or skill gaps, coordinate assignments, improve handoffs, and coach teams on communication, documentation, escalation, and follow-through.

Security, Compliance, and Operational Risk
  
  

* Ensure assigned accounts follow Centroid’s security, privacy, access-management, audit, data-handling, and compliance requirements.
* Track evidence and follow-up for access approvals, onboarding, offboarding, controls, audit requests, security findings, patching needs, and other risks.

Reporting, Continuous Improvement, and Growth
  
  

* Provide clear reporting on SLAs, ticket trends, incidents, changes, availability, risks, projects, utilization, financials, and improvement actions.
* Use service data to spot recurring issues, process gaps, automation opportunities, and practical service improvements.
* Partner with Sales, Consulting, solution architects, and leadership on renewals, proposals, service expansion, and opportunities that create client value.

Additional Expectations
  
  
This is a remote position with limited travel. The SDM must be able to support client escalations, global team coordination, maintenance windows, and time-sensitive issues across time zones.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* 10+ years of enterprise IT or technology services experience, including 3 to 5 years leading service delivery, client accounts, operations, projects, or matrixed teams.
* Experience managing multiple client accounts, SLA-based services, ITSM processes, governance, escalations, financials, utilization, scope, reporting, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders and manage customer-facing service-delivery work.
* Strong communication, facilitation, negotiation, conflict-resolution, organization, and prioritization skills.
* Ability to turn complex technical and operational information into clear business communication and action plans.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ITIL Foundation or higher; PMP, Certified ScrumMaster, or another service or project management credential is helpful.
* Experience with a Managed Services Provider supporting 24x7 enterprise operations and Oracle application, database, integration, infrastructure, or engineered-system services.
* Working knowledge of OCI, Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, hybrid environments, monitoring, patching, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, security, and identity and access management.
* Familiarity with HaloPSA, ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, OpenAir, or similar platforms, plus experience with executive reviews, renewals, and service-growth opportunities.

Why Join Centroid
  
  
At Centroid, you will work with experienced teams, support meaningful client outcomes, and grow your career in a collaborative Cloud Managed Services environment. This role offers the opportunity to lead important client relationships, strengthen delivery practices, and make a visible impact across clients and internal teams.

We're building a workplace where employees can grow their careers, make an impact, and help shape the future of telecommunications across Arizona. Our employees are helping connect communities, expand broadband access, and bring meaningful technology infrastructure to underserved areas throughout the state.
  
  
**Department:**
Enterprise Program Management
  
  
**Reports to:**
Senior Director of Enterprise Program Management
  
  
**Location:**
Arizona – Statewide (Field/Hybrid)
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Senior Program Manager, Network Build leads the delivery of fiber network construction across one or more markets and the Design Areas within them. This role owns the plan for each market from an accepted design package through an operational network, and is accountable for keeping every Design Area moving through the same sixteen milestones, from package accepted to operational. The Senior Program Manager sets the standard for how the Network Build Program Managers plan, report and escalate, and is the primary voice of the build program to senior leaders. The role also helps build and refine the processes the team runs on, so that planning, handoffs, reporting and vendor payment become more consistent and more efficient as the program grows.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Plan and schedule ownership**

* Own the schedule and plan logic for assigned markets, including dependencies, crew capacity, quantities, production rates and weather effects, and keep them accurate as work moves from Project Controls to the Network Build team.
* Maintain the sixteen-milestone plan for every Design Area, and decide when a milestone is complete using evidence from the responsible team rather than assumption.
* Re-forecast dates when crew counts, weather, permits or materials change, and explain the effect on the market finish date.

**Milestone management and handoffs**

* Confirm the Operational state of each Design Area. The Senior Program Manager and the Network Build Program Managers confirm it; no other team does.
* Manage the release of each project to construction, including the handoff to Supply Chain for materials staging and the notice to Sales and Marketing.
* In Prescott, run the pre-construction approval sequence: Construction completes the utility locates and reports to the Program Manager, the Program Manager schedules the pre-construction walks, Design and Engineering makes comments and corrections, the City approves, and Construction is then released.

**Cross-functional leadership**

* Coordinate Design and Engineering, the Permit Specialist, Supply Chain, Construction, Sales and Marketing and the Network Operations Center so that each handoff is clean and dated.
* Hold a weekly meeting with each team on Thursday or Friday, collect final updates by Monday, and prepare the reports for the Wednesday 30-60-90 day review.
* Escalate risks, delays and decisions early, with a recommendation and the effect on schedule and cost.

**Vendor and financial oversight**

* Make sure construction vendors are paid accurately and on time by reviewing each submitted invoice against the approved design prints before it is entered for payment.
* Track budget against forecast for each Design Area and flag variances to leadership.

**Reporting and governance**

* Report status using four labels: On Track, At-Risk, Off-Track and Complete.
* Track grant-funded markets against their commitments and prepare the reporting those programs require.
* Review the plan data for accuracy each week, and correct gaps before reports are issued.
* Communicate directly with executives and senior leaders in writing and in meetings, presenting status, risks, decisions and recommendations in plain language with the conclusion first.

**Team leadership**

* Coach and review the work of the Network Build Program Managers, set consistent reporting standards, and step in on the most complex or at-risk markets.

**Process development and improvement**

* Help design and document the processes the Network Build team follows, including milestone definitions, handoffs between teams, schedule updates, reporting and vendor invoice review.
* Review how the processes work in practice each quarter, identify recurring delays, rework and gaps, and recommend and lead improvements.
* Turn lessons from completed Design Areas into updated standards, templates and checklists that every Network Build Program Manager uses.
* Work with Design and Engineering, Permitting, Supply Chain, Construction, Sales and Marketing and the Network Operations Center to agree on process changes before they are adopted.
* Train and coach the Network Build Program Managers on new and revised processes, and confirm that they are followed.

**Qualifications**

* A bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, business or a related field, or equivalent experience.

* Middleware Technologies and Enterprise Integration Services

As a key technology leader, the Senior Manager will drive innovation, modernization, automation, security, resilience, and operational efficiency across Qatar Airways' enterprise platforms. The position plays a pivotal role in ensuring the stability and scalability of business-critical services while enabling the organization's digital transformation agenda.

Title: Manager, IT Infrastructure Center of Excellence
Description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title:**
Manager, IT Infrastructure Center of Excellence
  
  
**Reporting To:**
Director, Information Technology Infrastructure & Services Delivery
  
  
**Business Unit / Function:**
Pr ocurement & Business Support
  
  
**Department:**
Information Technology
  
  
**Why This Role Matters**
Lead infrastructure technical excellence through standards, solution design, and engineering across Maaden sites. Translate approved IT direction into reliable, scalable infrastructure and reusable capabilities. Enable IT Services Delivery to operate and support services effectively, while keeping day-to-day operations and enterprise strategy ownership with the accountable teams.
  
  
**What You Will Deliver**
Manage the infrastructure Center of Excellence for networks, systems, datacenters, and databases. Provide technical requirements, design assurance, engineering guidance and knowledge transfer, aligned with enterprise architecture and the Director’s approved priorities.
  
  
**Contract Strategy and Governance**
Develop infrastructure standards, reference architectures, and technology roadmaps within enterprise architecture principles. Define technical specifications and acceptance criteria for infrastructure solutions and sourcing. Govern technology selection, standard configurations, and lifecycle plans, including upgrades, refresh, and retirement. Assess emerging technologies for business fit, interoperability, capacity, and supportability. Recommend designs and exceptions through established architecture authorities; enterprise policy and strategy remain with the accountable leaders .
  
  
**Contract Administration and Compliance**
Maintain design documentation, configuration baselines, and engineering procedures. Govern and oversee infrastructure projects within delegated authority, coordinating with PMO and IT Services Delivery on scope, delivery plans, milestones, budgets, risks, dependencies, architecture and standards compliance, acceptance, and transition to operations. Review supplier deliverables against agreed specifications and standards. Coordinate design assurance, testing, and operational handover with IT Services Delivery, including support documentation and knowledge transfer. Verify that designs address integration, availability, capacity, recovery, and maintainability before transition. Document technical deviations and corrective actions and escalate non-compliance through the responsible governance and contract owners.
  
  
**Contractor Performance Management**
Assess suppliers’ technical deliverables and engineering quality against agreed requirements. Define and monitor infrastructure service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs) in coordination with IT Services Delivery and relevant stakeholders; review performance against agreed targets, report deviations and drive corrective actions and continual design improvement. Use recurring-problem evidence from IT Services Delivery to inform engineering improvements. Develop infrastructure automation and DevOps engineering practices with delivery teams to improve repeatability and reduce manual work. Coach technical staff, share reusable designs and strengthen internal engineering capability. Daily operations, service support, and operational supplier SLA management remain with IT Services Delivery
  
  
**Commercial and Cost Management**
Develop capacity and lifecycle recommendations using utilization, availability, and technology requirements. Evaluate infrastructure options for standardization, reuse, and cost efficiency. Provide technical input to procurement, project estimates, and purchase requisitions within assigned responsibility; escalate funding and commercial decisions to the authorized owners. Manage and oversee infrastructure contracts, particularly the Infrastructure & Service Delivery managed service provider contract, within delegated authority and in coordination with Procurement, Legal, IT Services Delivery and relevant stakeholders. Validate technical scope, deliverables and SLAs/KPIs; oversee contractual compliance, performance reviews, escalations, corrective actions, changes, renewals, and exit/transition planning. Contract approvals remain with authorized signatories, and day-to-day operational ownership remains with IT Services Delivery.
  
  
**Risk, HSE and Business Continuity**
Define infrastructure resilience, backup and recovery design requirements with business continuity, security, and delivery teams. Support disaster recovery planning and testing; review technical findings and track engineering improvements. Apply relevant site HSE requirements during infrastructure work and escalate risks. Backup operations, incident response, and service restoration remain with IT Services Delivery.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**
Infrastructure designs meet agreed standards and business requirements; documented handovers enable effective support. Roadmaps address capacity, lifecycle, and resilience needs. Technical assurance findings are resolved, or formally escalated, recurring issues inform engineering improvements, and delivery teams can reuse documented designs and procedures. Performance targets are agreed through the established management process.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in computer science or computer engineering. ITIL Foundation and ISO 20000-1 service management certification (preferred)
  
  
**Experience**
8–10 years of experience in IT service management, infrastructure, and end-user services, with practical technical requirements, infrastructure project, and standards experience. Good understanding of ITIL and ISO 20000 service management frameworks.
  
  
**Skills That Matter**
Infrastructure planning and technical documentation; analytical diagnosis and problem solving; emerging technology assessment; continuous improvement; stakeholder collaboration and communication; planning and prioritization; people leadership and capability development. Translate operational needs into clear technical specifications and explain design recommendations to technical and management audiences

Title: VP, Head of Cloud Solutions
Description:
**JOB SUMMARY:**

We are seeking a senior technology leader to own CFSB's cloud strategy, platform engineering, and cloud operating model. Reporting to the [CIO/CTO], this role owns the multi-year cloud roadmap and leads the team that builds and runs the bank's cloud platform — the landing zones, automation, networking, and controls that every other technology team builds on.

This is a hands-on leadership role in a regulated environment. You should be equally comfortable presenting a cloud investment case to executive leadership, reviewing an infrastructure-as-code pull request with an engineer, and explaining to an examiner how cloud controls are designed and evidenced. We expect recommendations and tradeoffs, not problems to be assigned.

The role manages five to eight cloud engineers and partners closely with Information Security, Risk, Compliance, Enterprise Architecture, and the product squads. You are the accountable technology owner for how security and regulatory requirements are implemented and evidenced in the cloud. The team participates in a shared on-call rotation and provides after-hours support to the business; this role serves as its senior escalation point.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

***Cloud Strategy and Roadmap***

* Own and maintain the multi-year cloud strategy and migration roadmap, sequenced against business priorities, risk appetite, and budget cycles.
* Translate strategy into executive-ready business cases and committee-level materials, and secure funding and alignment for cloud investments.
* Set cloud target architecture and standards with Enterprise Architecture — reference patterns, approved services, and guardrails for what teams may build.
* Define and report program metrics — migration progress, platform reliability, control coverage, and unit cost trends — and advise leaders on build-versus-buy and cloud-versus-on-premises decisions.

***Platform and Infrastructure Engineering***

* Lead the design, build, and operation of the cloud platform: multi-account landing zones, identity and access, network architecture and hybrid connectivity, observability, backup, and resilience.
* Establish infrastructure-as-code and pipeline-based delivery as the default provisioning mechanism, and eliminate manual, undocumented change.
* Own the cloud CI/CD, container, and DevOps tooling that squads consume, and enforce engineering standards for code review, environment promotion, change management, and documentation.
* Ensure environments meet availability and recovery objectives; lead resilience testing and serve as senior escalation point for major incidents through to permanent corrective action.

***Cloud Security, Risk, and Regulatory Compliance***

* Own the implementation and evidencing of cloud technical controls that satisfy policies and standards set by Information Security, Risk, and Compliance, and escalate gaps where cloud reality and policy diverge.
* Serve as the cloud subject matter expert in internal audit, external audit, and regulatory examinations, including FFIEC and GLBA obligations, and produce control evidence and remediation plans.
* Embed guardrails as code — configuration baselines, encryption and key management, privileged access controls, and continuous compliance monitoring — and remediate findings and drift to agreed timelines.
* Contribute cloud expertise to risk assessments, third-party technology reviews, and change and exception review boards; provide input to cloud policies as a reviewer, with ownership, approval, and risk acceptance resting with the second-line functions.

***Cost Management and Vendor Relationship***

* Own the cloud budget: forecast spend, cost savings plan, and explain variances to Finance and the [CIO/CTO].
* Manage the AWS relationship, including account team engagement, support tier decisions, and technical escalation; provide technical input to procurement and renewals, with commercial negotiation led by Procurement and Vendor Management.

***Leadership and Team Development***

* Recruit, develop, and retain cloud engineers; set goals, coach, conduct performance reviews, and create clear technical development paths so no critical capability rests on a single person.
* Balance squad-embedded assignments against core platform work as priorities shift, and represent cloud engineering in technology leadership forums.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:**

***Technical***

* Deep hands-on AWS expertise across IAM, networking, compute, storage, database, and cost management.
* Strong cloud networking: VPC and subnet design, Transit Gateway, CloudWAN, segmentation, and hybrid connectivity.
* Proven infrastructure-as-code experience, Terraform preferred — modules, state, and refactoring into code.
* Experience with Git-based workflows, CI/CD, and container platforms such as ECS or EKS at production scale.
* Cloud security and multi-account governance: least-privilege IAM, encryption, secrets, and Control Tower.
* Capable of leading complex, multi-step, large scale infrastructure related activities like data-center exit migrations, VPN cutovers, Database migrations, among others.

***Professional***

* Sound judgment under constraint, balancing delivery speed against risk, cost, and regulatory obligation.
* Technical credibility with engineers and fluency in front of executives, auditors, and examiners.
* Succeeds through Security, Risk, and delivery teams, with a strong hiring and development record.
* Proven track record leading teams towards successful and timely execution of commitments to executive leadership and board of directors.

**EDUCATION, TRAINING, AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years in technology infrastructure, platform, or cloud engineering, including 3+ years leading technical teams.
* Demonstrated ownership of a production cloud environment at enterprise scale, not solely advisory, architecture-only, or program-management exposure.
* Experience in a regulated industry with formal audit, control, and change-management discipline, including direct support of audits or examinations; financial services experience and familiarity with FFIEC guidance and GLBA preferred.

Title: Data Center Infrastructure Delivery Manager, AWS DC Operations Infra Delivery - VAR
Description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Transform the backbone of digital infrastructure by leading a dynamic team that builds and maintains the critical networks powering global technology. In this role, you'll drive operational excellence, optimize data center deployment strategies, and create seamless connectivity solutions that support Amazon's massive technological ecosystem.  
  
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the clouds running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The ideal candidate will possess a technology background that enables them to understand the complexities of the sophisticated network architecture of Amazon data centers. To be a qualified candidate for this role you must have experience operating in large-scale data center or a background in telecom networks and display a demonstrated ability to think broadly and strategically, as this is needed to align the future of Infrastructure Delivery with the larger objectives of the business.  
You will be responsible for managing a group of technicians who are installing and building server rack capacity for our customers. You must be passionate about Customer Experience, think and act globally and want to contribute to innovations in Data Center Infrastructure.  
Managing and developing teams of technicians and engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring the highest levels of performance.  
Delivering capacity to existing Data Centers  
Helping build and bring online new Data Centers  
Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve  
Assisting & managing relationships with external vendors & contractors  
Liaising with internal teams & management groups  
Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health & Safety standards in all our Data Centers  
Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes  
Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc.  
This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.  
  
Essential Requirements  
Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed  
Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational  
Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility  
Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.  
US citizenship required

------------------------

* 2+ years of in a data center technology role experience
* 2+ years of TCP/IP networking, network cabling, fiber, optic types, and test equipment experience
* 2+ years of in a management or team lead function experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in an IT-related field (e.g., Computer Science, Network Engineering), or experience in professional or military IT-related roles
* Knowledge of networking infrastructure topology
* Work a flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays
* Experience conducting interviews and making effective hiring decisions

Title: Technical Program Manager, Network
Description:
**About Cape**
Cape is America’s privacy-first mobile carrier. Our mission is to be a force for good in global wireless. Cape was founded in 2022 by people who believe privacy is a fundamental right, not a luxury to be traded away. Our journey began when our founder recognized a critical vulnerability in our modern world: everyone relies on the same stagnant cellular infrastructure and legacy systems that track our every movement, monitor and profile our connections, and lose and sell our personal data.
  
  
Instead of accepting the status quo, we decided to fix it. National security professionals, journalists, parents, and everyone in between can stay connected
*and*
have privacy.
  
  
We didn’t just build a layer on top of old tech; we built America’s most private and secure mobile carrier from the ground up. By building our own network from scratch, we are able to design and build a suite of privacy and security features that no other carrier on the planet can offer.
  
  
Today, Cape provides our secure network to consumers, businesses, and government agencies alike. We closed our Series C in March 2026, and we are scaling rapidly, with the goal of giving people back control of their most personal information.
  
  
**The Team**
At Cape, we are the architects of a privacy-centric movement that is just getting started. We are relentless builders, constantly innovating at the edge of what's possible in telecommunications. We operate on a foundation of high trust and high expectations. Our structure is flat, and collaboration matters more than hierarchy. As a member of our team, you will collaborate with world-class engineers, architects, and visionaries, and work across organizational lines to solve "impossible" problems and deliver mission-critical results for our users every single day.
  
  
**The Role:**
Cape's network team designs how traffic actually moves through our infrastructure: routing, regional connectivity, subscriber provisioning, and the vendor-implemented changes that make it all work. Right now, that work is coordinated ad hoc, and the team needs someone to take real ownership of task tracking, timeline accountability, and communication across engineering, business development, and vendors. This role is the first of its kind in the network team. We're looking for a Program Manager who is technical enough to challenge engineering estimates, sanity-check what BD is promising customers, and set delivery timelines the team can actually hit.
  
  
You'll work in close partnership with the network operations lead to roadmap upcoming work, surface dependencies and conflicts before they become fire drills, and keep vendors accountable to what they've committed to. Telco or network experience is a plus, but we care more about startup instincts and a bias toward realistic, forward-moving plans than about a background in telecom specifically.
  
  
**What You'll Work On:**

* Own Jira hygiene and task tracking for the network team, bringing structure to work that is currently coordinated informally
* Build a reliable system for tracking work, exposing dependencies, and catching timeline slips early, across network engineering, BD, and vendors
* Partner closely with the network team's technical lead to roadmap infrastructure work like routing, regional connectivity, subscriber provisioning, and cloud/vendor integrations

**About Atos Group**
Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 54,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €7.2 billion, operating in 54 countries under two brands - Atos for services and Eviden for products and systems. European number one in cybersecurity and a leader in cloud, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries.
