Title: INNOVATION AND TECHNOLOGY NETWORK MANAGER - (NON-CLASSIFIED) *
Description:
The Position
  
  
The City of Riverside, Innovation and Technology Department (IT) is accepting applications for the position of
**INNOVATION AND TECHNOLOGY NETWORK MANAGER to**
fill one (1) vacancy in the
**Network Division**
**.**
The eligibility list established may be used to fill the current and/or upcoming vacancies within this classification for up to six 6 months.
  
  
The Network Manager position will lead and perform advanced-level network administration and operational oversight as part of the City's Network Team, supporting the daily availability, performance, and security of enterprise-wide communications infrastructure that includes WAN/LAN, data center, wireless, voice, and public safety networks. This role is responsible for coordinating day-to-day network operations such as monitoring and responding to alerts, troubleshooting and resolving escalated incidents, managing configurations and change activities, overseeing backups and redundancy, maintaining network documentation and standards, and coordinating vendor support and carrier services. In addition, the Network Manager will guide and mentor technical staff, collaborate closely with other IT teams and City departments, and ensure networks supporting cameras, radio systems, and mission-critical applications remain highly available, secure, and compliant, while also contributing to longer-term planning, upgrades, and modernization initiatives to meet the evolving needs of City services and the community
  
  
Under general supervision, the Innovation and Technology Network Manager is to plan, organize and direct information technology functions related to Networking, Data Center Operation, and Enterprise Applications or Enterprise Project Management Applications and to perform related work as required.
  
  

* Actual job classification is Innovation and Technology Officer II (Non-Classified). Positions designated as non-classified are exempt from the classified service. The incumbent will be appointed "at-will" and serve at the pleasure of the City Manager.

**For positions indicating a salary range from 1N – 2X, the top 15% of the pay range cannot be offered upon hire or upon an employee promotion.**
Work Performed
  
  
Typical duties may include, but are not limited to, the following:
  
  

* Develop and implement project plans to accomplish work group objectives and assign work and monitor performance. Take action in the full range of formal personnel activities, and provide contract oversight in conjunction within the Innovation and Technology Department.
* Provide subject matter expertise in highly complex mission critical enterprise-wide systems which require expertise in multiple industry areas.
* Prepare, negotiate and present budget and other funding proposals; monitor expenditures and operate within budget allocation.
* Develop strategic plans and implement operational plans to provide information technology infrastructure to support the City's/Department's business goals; and oversee one or more of the following technical areas: Enterprise Applications or Enterprise Project Manager Applications, Networking, and Data Center Operations.

When assigned to Enterprise Applications or Enterprise Project Management Applications:
  
  

* Manage all activities related to the design, development and implementation of information systems and software applications.
* Oversee maintenance, support and upgrade of existing systems and applications.
* Confirm software integration into existing systems, meets functional requirements, systems compliance and interface specifications.
* Design, develop, and install enhancements and upgrades to systems and application software.
* Compile and maintain an inventory of all software and system assets, and corresponding contracts and agreements.
* Develop training materials for end users and conduct training as necessary.

**When Assigned To Networking**

* Plan, coordinate and supervise activities of a complex communications infrastructure, including radio, microwave and wireless communications, voice services, including WAN/LAN technology, switches, routers and fiber optics, and supporting management applications.
* Plan, coordinate and supervise activities of over 1,000 security cameras.
* Establish schedules and internal controls to meet deadlines.
* Manage city-owned or leased equipment and line and service installation and expansion.
* Identify areas for improvement and implement and maintain new or improved services to meet changing technical and customer requirements.
* Review, evaluate and recommend telecommunications hardware and software packages.

**When Assigned To Data Center Operations**

* Plan, coordinate and supervise the enterprise computing services including messaging and collaboration software including, email, unified communications, servers, desktop and server virtualization technologies, enterprise desktop management tools, data storage and backup infrastructure, Active Directory, VPN and system monitoring tools.
* Design and implement short and long-term strategic plans to ensure system capacity meets existing and future requirements.
* Ensure a high level of application, server and storage, and enterprise system availability.
* Develop, implement, and maintain standard operating procedures, and associated training plans for related infrastructure operations.
* Plan the acquisition and installation of hardware equipment, applicable enterprise system software and maintenance agreements.
* Maintain data center facilities.
* Assist with the planning and deployment of server, storage infrastructure and enterprise system security measures.
* Develop, implement and maintain an efficient, well documented disaster recovery plan.

**Qualifications**
**OPTION I:**

* Education: A Master's degree in computer science, information systems or public/business administration.
* Experience: Three years of considerable, progressively responsible experience in technical or administrative or staff capacity with responsibility for planning, organizing, and implementing information system programs and projects, including one year of supervisory experience.

**Option Ii**

* Education: Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university with major course work in computer science, information systems, electronics engineering, voice/data communications, public/business administration or a related field.
* Experience: Four years of considerable, progressively responsible experience in technical or administrative or staff capacity with responsibility for planning, organizing and implementing information system programs and projects, including one year of supervisory experience.

**Option Iii**

* Education: Associate of Arts degree from an accredited college or university with major course work in computer science, information systems, electronics engineering voice/data communications, public/business administration or related field.
* Experience: Six years of considerable, progressively responsible experience in technical or administrative or staff capacity with responsibility for planning, organizing and implementing information system programs and projects, including one year of supervisory experience.

**Option Iv**

* Education: Equivalent of the completion of the twelfth grade.
* Experience: Eight years of considerable, progressively responsible experience in technical or administrative or staff capacity with responsibility for planning, organizing and implementing information system programs and projects, including one year of supervisory experience.

**Necessary Special Qualifications**

* When assigned to the Police Department, must be able to successfully pass an extensive police background.

**Network Manager Highly Desirables**

* Enterprise Network Architecture and Engineering: Advanced experience designing, implementing, and managing large-scale WAN/LAN environments, including routing and switching, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, fiber-optic infrastructure, wireless networking, network segmentation, SD-WAN, and enterprise connectivity.
* Network Leadership and Staff Development: Proven success managing technical teams, establishing performance expectations, delegating responsibilities, mentoring employees, addressing performance deficiencies, and maintaining accountability for operational and project outcomes.
* Project Management and Strategic Planning: Demonstrated ability to independently plan, budget, coordinate, and deliver complex infrastructure projects while managing competing priorities, project risks, stakeholder expectations, and long-term technology modernization strategies.
* Operational Excellence and Infrastructure Lifecycle Management: Extensive experience establishing and enforcing network operational standards, preventive maintenance programs, patch management, change control procedures, hardware lifecycle planning, asset management, and comprehensive technical documentation.
* Network Security, Resiliency, and Business Continuity: Strong background implementing enterprise security controls, firewalls, Zero Trust principles, secure connectivity, redundancy, disaster recovery, and high-availability solutions supporting mission-critical services.
* Financial, Procurement, and Vendor Management: Proven experience developing and managing technology budgets, evaluating procurement requirements, administering vendor contracts, monitoring service-level agreements, validating deliverables, and maintaining financial accountability.
* Communication, Collaboration, and Organizational Accountability: Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with demonstrated success proactively communicating project status, identifying and escalating risks, maintaining follow-through, coordinating across departments, and presenting technical information to executive leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
* Enterprise Monitoring, Troubleshooting, and Continuous Improvement: Advanced experience managing enterprise network monitoring, incident response, root-cause analysis, performance optimization, capacity planning, network automation, and continuous service improvement initiatives.
* Public Safety and Mission-Critical Infrastructure: Experience managing complex networking environments supporting public safety communications, radio and microwave systems, surveillance cameras, telecommunications, fiber infrastructure, and other essential 24/7 government or enterprise services.

Description:

Manager, Cloud Ops
  
  
**POSITION SUMMARY:**

You will lead a team of IT professionals, ensuring the smooth functioning of our systems, services, and software applications. Your strategic vision and technical expertise will drive innovation, efficiency, and security across all IT initiatives.
  
  
**PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment, promoting teamwork and professional development.
* Oversee the design, implementation, and maintenance of the organization's IT infrastructure.

Title: Cloud Infrastructure Manager
Description:
We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.
  
  
Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).
  
  
This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.
  
  
**About Our Team**
We are seeking an experienced, hands-on
**Cloud Infrastructure Manager**
to lead the team responsible for the secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-effective operation of Qira’s multi-region Azure AI platform.
  
  
This role owns platform architecture, production reliability, disaster recovery, capacity planning, and delivery infrastructure across
**Azure Front Door, Application Gateway, Azure Container Apps, Microsoft Foundry, Azure API Management, and GitHub Actions**
.
  
  
The successful candidate combines deep Azure expertise with strong people leadership and operational accountability. Working across application development, AI engineering, data, security, and business teams, this leader will translate business requirements into resilient infrastructure, controlled releases, and measurable service outcomes.
  
  
**Location:**
Chicago, IL (Hybrid; 3 days onsite, 2 days remote)
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Platform Leadership Team Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop the cloud platform team while maintaining hands-on technical leadership and sustainable support coverage.
* Own the platform roadmap, delivery priorities, operational risks, vendor relationships, and escalation paths.
* Establish clear service ownership and accountability across development, AI engineering, data, and security teams.

**Multi-Region Infrastructure Disaster Recovery**

* Design and operate resilient multi-region Azure environments using appropriate active-active and active-passive patterns, availability zones, and dependency-aware routing.
* Define and manage service-level objectives, recovery time objectives (RTO), and recovery point objectives (RPO).
* Maintain and test regional failover, failback, backup, and recovery processes across PostgreSQL, Redis, storage, containers, configuration, and AI services.

**Networking AI Platform Operations**

* Manage Azure Front Door, Application Gateway, WAF policies, DNS, TLS, virtual networks, private endpoints, firewalls, egress controls, and hybrid connectivity.
* Oversee Microsoft Foundry resources, model deployments, access controls, private connectivity, model lifecycle, capacity, quotas, and regional availability.
* Partner with AI engineering and security on controlled model rollouts, content safety, prompt-injection and data-exfiltration protections, and secure access to AI tools and data.

**API, Containers Platform Delivery**

* Own Azure API Management configuration and governance, including authentication, authorization, versioning, tenant isolation, routing, throttling, load balancing, and observability.
* Operate Azure Container Apps, including workload profiles, scaling, health probes, managed identities, zone redundancy, traffic splitting, and rollback.
* Maintain reusable Infrastructure as Code and Policy as Code, automated validation, configuration-drift detection, and staged multi-region deployments.

**GitHub Actions CI/CD**

* Own secure self-hosted GitHub Actions runners in Azure, including provisioning, autoscaling, patching, isolation, capacity, logging, and queue monitoring.
* Apply least-privilege access, OIDC workload federation, protected production environments, workflow controls, and secure artifact management.
* Maintain reliable deployment and recovery paths during regional outages.

**Reliability, Security Governance**

* Establish actionable monitoring, alerting, synthetic testing, distributed tracing, and service dashboards using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, and KQL.
* Track platform availability, latency, AI model performance, throttling, regional capacity, and infrastructure health.
* Lead incident response, escalation, stakeholder communication, post-incident reviews, and corrective actions.
* Implement Zero Trust principles using Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, RBAC, Azure Policy, Key Vault, Defender for Cloud, and Microsoft Sentinel.
* Support applicable data residency, retention, privacy, and compliance requirements in partnership with legal and security teams.

**Financial Capacity Management**

* Own cloud infrastructure budgets, demand forecasting, capacity planning, cost allocation, and optimization.
* Balance AI inference capacity, regional recovery headroom, infrastructure performance, and cost against business demand and service objectives.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
* 10+ years of relevant cloud infrastructure or platform engineering experience, including significant hands-on Azure production operations.
* People leadership experience, and experience with cross-functional delivery, incident management, and operational ownership of business-critical, multi-region services.
* Production experience with Azure Front Door, Application Gateway, Container Apps, API Management, and Microsoft Foundry or related Azure AI model-serving services.
* Experience with GitHub Actions and secure self-hosted runners in Azure, including workload federation, runner isolation, and deployment controls.
* Experience with Azure networking, identity, security, observability, and KQL skills, with practical knowledge of PostgreSQL and Redis.
* Experience with Terraform, Bicep, or comparable Infrastructure as Code tooling, Policy as Code, Git-based change control, CI/CD, and automated testing.
* Experience assessing PowerShell, Node.js, Python, and Java applications for cloud deployment, scalability, supportability, and security.
* Experience with vendor management, automation, capacity planning, and cloud cost optimization.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Relevant Azure architecture, administration, security, or DevOps certifications.
* Additional cloud-provider or multi-cloud experience.
* Chinese and/or Portuguese language skills.

The base salary budgeted range for this position is $185K - $210K. Individuals may also be considered for bonus and/or commission.

**WHO WE ARE**

When it comes to health, we’re always looking for ways to push for better. It’s why we were founded in the first place. In 1957, our founder, pharmacist William Wilkinson, witnessed a mother sacrifice her health by forgoing her own medicine to pay for her sick daughter’s prescription. He knew there had to be a better way. So, he introduced North America’s first prepaid drug plan, and GreenShield was born as a not-for-profit with a mission to support better health for all Canadians.

* Collaborate with CISO and peers to set strategic directions and roadmaps in alignment with business strategy and risk appetite
* Present security posture, threat landscape and metrics to senior audiences
* Own security operations budget and vendor strategy ensuring cost optimization and technology alignment with enterprise
* Ensure control operating effectiveness to support regulatory and compliance requirements (SOC2, ISO27001, NIST-CSF)
* Influence enterprise security architecture roadmap

* Strong technical knowledge in network and endpoint security
* Knowledge in application security and hardening
* Expert knowledge in cyber incident response technologies and understanding of adversarial techniques, tactics, and procedures (TTPs).
* Proficient in security event monitoring, threat intelligence, security operations center (SOC), and incident response technologies
* Strong leadership capabilities to motivate, build, develop and lead effective teams to achieve results.
* Verbal and written communication with a spectrum of senior management, executives, users, other technical teams, external customers, to enable and influence business outcomes.
* Strong problem-solving abilities and ability to work effectively under pressure.
* An accomplished facilitator with excellent interpersonal and communications skills that support working effectively in multi-disciplinary and multiple location team environments.
* Experience in partnering with technology, product and program management teams.
* Highly developed planning, organizing and negotiating skills; can manage multiple tasks, meet tight deadlines and respond to changing priorities.

**NICE TO HAVEs**

* University degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science or equivalent.
* Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)
* Certificate of Cloud Security Knowledge (CCSKv4)

Range exempt

Determined using relevant experience, skills, internal equity and current market data.

Eligible for a discretionary target bonus.

At GreenShield, our culture is where purpose meets passion and performance. Our teams work as one to deliver meaningful, measurable impact for the people and communities we serve.

Title: Senior Manager, Enterprise Data & Cloud Modernization
Description:
**Job Description**

  

**Vacancy Status:** This posting is for a new vacancy within the organization and is open to new applications.

This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to the Markham Elevation Centre or the Oshawa Elevation Centre at least three times per week.

  

**The Team & Opportunity**
--------------------------

  

The Enterprise Data team is responsible for supporting and modernizing the data platforms that enable analytics, artificial intelligence, customer engagement, strategic planning, and other enterprise capabilities across GM.

  

We are building a new team to support the existing legacy environment while migrating and transforming the architecture to a cloud-based platform. This role will help establish the engineering standards, reusable platform capabilities, delivery automation, and operational practices required for a secure, scalable, governed, and reliable cloud data ecosystem.

  

The ideal candidate is a strategic, hands-on technology leader with a track record of operating and modernizing complex enterprise data environments. They can lead multidisciplinary teams across data engineering, business analysis, data quality, and governance; align business and technology stakeholders around a clear modernization roadmap; and deliver large-scale migration while protecting the reliability of existing services. They understand how to build trusted, well-governed data foundations that enable enterprise-wide analytics and AI adoption.

  

**The Role**
------------

As the Senior Manager, Enterprise Data & Cloud Modernization, you will lead the team responsible for the day-to-day health and continued operation of the existing enterprise data warehouse, as well as its modernization and migration to a cloud-based environment. You will set direction, establish delivery and operational priorities, and ensure the platform evolves to meet the needs of GM Canada and the wider enterprise.

You will lead a multidisciplinary team comprising three Data Engineering, Cloud Migration & Platforms Engineers; one Business Analyst, Enterprise Data & Cloud Migration; one Data Validation & Data Quality Analyst, Enterprise Data; and one Data Governance Analyst. You will bring these capabilities together into a coordinated operating model that delivers reliable services, high-quality and well-governed data, and a successful migration. The cloud implementation may be Azure/Databricks, Google Cloud Platform, or another direction based on platform and business requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Set the vision, strategy, roadmap, and operating priorities for the enterprise data environment, balancing current service needs with modernization and migration objectives.
* Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team across data engineering, business analysis, data validation and quality, and data governance; clarify accountability, establish expectations, and support professional growth.
* Maintain the reliability, availability, performance, security, and supportability of the existing enterprise data warehouse and its critical data pipelines.
* Lead the planning and execution of the enterprise data warehouse migration to a cloud-based environment, including scope, sequencing, dependencies, risks, resourcing, milestones, and business readiness.
* Direct modernization of data architecture, platforms, pipelines, processes, and controls to improve scalability, automation, resilience, maintainability, and cost effectiveness.
* Establish a practical transition strategy that protects business continuity, manages legacy and cloud coexistence, and ensures migrated workloads and data meet agreed operational and business requirements.
* Ensure migration outcomes are validated through appropriate testing, reconciliation, data-quality controls, business acceptance, and production-readiness reviews.
* Set expectations for engineering standards and practices, including architecture, automation, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, testing, observability, incident response, and documentation.
* Establish and oversee data-quality practices that monitor completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and schema conformance across source, pipeline, and warehouse data.
* Lead data governance practices that support clear ownership, stewardship, definitions, metadata, lineage, access controls, classification, retention, and responsible use of enterprise data.
* Build trusted relationships with business leaders, GM Canada stakeholders, enterprise data consumers, technology partners, security and risk teams, and global platform organizations.
* Translate business priorities into a sequenced and measurable data roadmap, ensuring stakeholder needs and downstream impacts are represented in decisions.
* Oversee requirements management, backlog priorities, sprint and release planning, delivery tracking, risk and issue management, and cross-team dependencies.
* Establish clear measures of success for platform health, service reliability, migration progress, data quality, governance, delivery outcomes, and customer or business impact.
* Ensure operational procedures, support models, escalation paths, service expectations, runbooks, and knowledge transfer are in place for both legacy and cloud environments.
* Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and data-informed decision-making across the team.
* Guide the development of secure, trusted, discoverable, and well-documented data foundations that can support analytics, artificial intelligence, and enterprise-wide AI adoption.
Communicate progress, decisions, risks, trade-offs, and outcomes clearly to senior stakeholders and delivery partners.  

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Management, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Significant progressive experience leading enterprise data, data engineering, data platforms, technology modernization, or related functions.
* Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary teams and delivering complex, enterprise-scale data or technology initiatives.
* Experience operating and modernizing enterprise data warehouses and production data platforms, preferably including Oracle-based environments.
* Proven ability to lead large-scale data platform or warehouse migrations, from assessment and planning through implementation, validation, and operational transition.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, data integration, ETL/ELT, cloud data platforms, data quality, and enterprise data operations.
* Experience establishing governance, security, privacy, quality, reliability, and operational practices for business-critical data environments.
* Ability to set strategic direction while maintaining sufficient technical depth to evaluate architecture, delivery approaches, risks, and trade-offs.
* Strong business and financial judgment, with the ability to prioritize work and resources against enterprise outcomes and operational needs.
* Excellent communication, relationship-building, and influencing skills, including the ability to align senior business and technical stakeholders.
* Strong change leadership skills and the ability to guide teams and stakeholders through complex modernization while sustaining current operations.
* Experience with Agile or iterative delivery models, portfolio or roadmap planning, and management of complex cross-functional dependencies.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, and risk-management capabilities.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience leading an on-premises Oracle data warehouse migration to Azure, Azure Databricks, Google Cloud Platform, or a comparable cloud data platform.
* Experience with Databricks, Delta Lake, BigQuery, Synapse, or equivalent enterprise data and lakehouse technologies.
* Familiarity with cloud platform engineering, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, data pipeline automation, and cloud operations.
* Experience establishing data observability, automated data-quality controls, reconciliation practices, and operational scorecards.
* Experience leading data governance and stewardship programs, including cataloging, lineage, classification, data ownership, and access management.
* Experience modernizing data platforms and operating models to support advanced analytics, machine learning, or enterprise AI use cases.
* Experience working in a large, matrixed, regulated, or security-sensitive enterprise environment.
Familiarity with enterprise tools and practices for Agile delivery, service management, documentation, and operational monitoring.

Title: Network Systems Manager
Description:
The Network Systems Manager oversees the daily operational engineering, maintenance, management, and continuous optimization of the enterprise network infrastructure supporting the Air Force National Capital Region (AFNCR). This role ensures maximum network uptime, robust cybersecurity enforcement, and seamless mission-critical data transport across both unclassified (NIPR) and classified (SIPR/JWICS) secure enclaves
  
  
The Manager provides senior-level technical direction and leadership to a team of engineers and technicians, ensuring full alignment with Department of Defense (DoD) regulations and program objectives.
  
  
Since 1976, SMS has specialized in modernizing legacy IT and sustaining complex enterprise environments for federal agencies. With the goal of building long-term partnerships with our customers, we invest in our employees by providing the training, tools, and support they need to keep critical missions operational, improve performance, and reduce risk. SMS is headquartered in McLean, Virginia, with offices and on-site operations at customer locations throughout the United States. For additional information on SMS, visit www.sms.com.
  
  
Submit your resume today!
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Infrastructure Management: Oversee the configuration, deployment, optimization, and lifecycle management of core data center and enterprise LAN/WAN infrastructure, including Cisco Nexus and Catalyst switches, routers, F5 Load Balancers, and Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE).
* Operational Leadership: Manage a specialized team of network engineers and operations center specialists; coordinate shift logs, escalate tickets, and lead complex troubleshooting across physical, virtual, and transport layers.
* Security & Compliance: Enforce physical and logical cybersecurity measures in strict adherence to DoD regulations. Ensure network baselines maintain STIG compliance, support Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M) remediation, and provide technical artifacts for RMF accreditation.
* Access Control & Crypto: Manage enterprise network systems utilizing Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco Catalyst Center for automated access control, device profiling, and policy enforcement. Support TACLANE/HAIPE encryptors (e.g., KG-175D) to secure sensitive data-in-transit.
* Performance Monitoring: Utilize telemetry and network monitoring tools (such as Cacti or other SNMP-based software) to closely track system capacity, application availability, and overall environmental health
* Documentation & Governance: Develop, enforce, and audit detailed Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), network topology maps, rack layouts, and precise asset tracking databases
* Stakeholder Liaison: Serve as a primary technical contact for government stakeholders, Contracting Officer Representatives (CORs), and prime program leadership regarding network upgrades and configuration modifications.

**Required Qualifications**

* CCNA required, CCNP preferred
* Active DoD Secret security clearance
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related field (Equivalent professional experience may be substituted on a 2-for-1 basis)
* Experience: Minimum of 8+ years of progressive experience in enterprise network engineering, network operations, or infrastructure support, with at least 2–3 years in a team lead, supervisory, or management capacity within a secure federal defense or intelligence environment.
* Network Access Control: Experience designing, implementing, operating, and maintaining IEEE 802.1X authentication and network access control solutions using Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE), including integration with wired network infrastructure, identity sources, endpoint profiling, policy administration, and troubleshooting authentication and authorization issues.
* Application Delivery and Access Management: Experience configuring, administering, and troubleshooting F5 BIG-IP Load Balancers, including Local Traffic Manager (LTM) and Access Policy Manager (APM) modules. Experience should include virtual servers, pools, health monitors, traffic policies, SSL/TLS configuration, high availability, and access-policy configuration.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Demonstrate experience managing automated network configuration workflows and software-defined network spaces.
* Familiarity with deploying multicast-based platforms (such as IPTV architectures) across enterprise local area networks.
* Exceptional communication skills, with a proven track record of managing interdisciplinary cleared teams and translating complex technical details into executive-level briefs.

**Salary Range - $130,000 - $175,000**
***SMS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.***

Halton Healthcare’s vision of Exemplary patient experiences, always, goes beyond just the patient experience; it has shaped our entire culture and remains at the core of every interaction in our organization, from our patients & families to our staff, physicians and volunteers. We believe in exemplary PEOPLE experiences always!

At Halton Healthcare you will thrive in a healthcare culture and environment that embraces inclusion, diversity and belonging with ‘exemplary patient care, always’ at the heart of everything we do. We empower our people to be the very best they can be so they can make a difference for our patients and the communities we serve.

Halton Healthcare takes great pride in providing quality, compassionate healthcare services to our rapidly growing communities. As a progressive and vibrant healthcare organization, we are committed to being an innovative center of excellence in community hospital care.

 **Job Description**

Halton Healthcare is seeking an experienced and strategic ICT Manager, Network & Telecommunications to lead the planning, delivery, and ongoing optimization of our non union network, telecommunications, unified communications, switchboard, audio/visual and related infrastructure services across our hospital sites. This role provides both operational and people leadership for critical technology services that support patient care, hospital operations, and organizational transformation initiatives.

Reporting to the Director, Information and Communication Technology, the successful candidate will oversee a multidisciplinary team operating in a 24x7 healthcare environment and is responsible for network services, telecommunications, switchboard operations, wireless infrastructure, audio/visual systems, and related technologies. This role plays a key part in ensuring infrastructure services remain secure, resilient, scalable, and aligned with the organization's digital health strategy. The role works closely with clinical and corporate programs, Facilities, Emergency Preparedness, Privacy, Cybersecurity and external partners to translate operational requirements and technology risks into sustainable roadmaps and investment priorities.

**This is what you will be doing:**

* Lead, coach and develop a multidisciplinary team supporting network, telecommunications, switchboard and related infrastructure services, establishing clear accountabilities, service standards and development plans.
* Ensure effective workforce planning, equitable scheduling, appropriate skill mix, succession planning and cross-training for a 24x7 hospital environment.
* Lead strategy, architecture and lifecycle management for network, wireless and connectivity services.
* Ensure secure, resilient and scalable connectivity across clinical, corporate, cloud and partner environments.
* Drive capacity planning, performance optimization and infrastructure modernization across all sites.
* Participate in the visioning, strategic planning, implementation and management of the Hospital's ICT Security program.
* Lead or support response to major incidents, Code Grey ICT events, carrier outages and other disruptions, making timely decisions to protect patient care and hospital operations.
* Lead projects from development to implementation including managing staff, external vendor, and consultant resources.
* Manage project teams and associated resources.
* Liaise with stakeholders, consultants, contractors and vendors working on a variety of projects to ensure project objectives and outcomes meet stated requirements.
* Initiate, plan, implement and support solutions that enable the strategic direction and vision of the organization and the ICT department.
* Participate in organization-wide strategic and tactical planning for Information and Communications Technology.
* Communicate and collaborate with Hospital leadership regarding ICT issues and function as an ICT consultant to senior leadership, department and program heads, managers, supervisors and medical staff.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum 10 years of progressive Information Technology experience, including applications, networking, operations, and telecommunications within a healthcare environment.
* Minimum 7 years of leadership experience working with diverse teams on day to day operations in addition to short and long term project deliverables.
* Industry standard technical certifications (MCSE/CCNA/CCNP/CISSP/PMP/ITIL)
* Demonstrated analytical and troubleshooting skills:
* Enterprise routing, switching, wireless, network access control, load balancing, DNS/DHCP/IP address management, internet and cloud connectivity, WAN/SD-WAN, quality of service, network monitoring and configuration management.
* Enterprise telephony, SIP, carrier services, call routing, contact centre/switchboard, voicemail, paging, mobile communications and unified communications platforms.
* Network security architecture, segmentation, firewalls, secure remote access, logging/monitoring, vulnerability management, privileged access and incident response.
* High availability, capacity planning, backup/recovery, lifecycle management, change enablement, configuration management and service-level management.
* Proficient knowledge of ITIL based processes.
* Proficient Business Analysis and Problem Solving skills.
* Demonstrated Project Management skills .
* Demonstrated communication skills, both verbal and written.
* Demonstrated time management skills.

  
**Additional Information**

**Hours:** Monday to Friday - 7.5 hour day shift; 0800-1600 (Hours are subject to change based on operational needs and the requirements of supporting a 24/7 hospital environment)

**Salary:** $60.091 to $75.140 per hour

Title: Director of IT Service Management
Description:
**Job Description**
**A Day in the Life:**
The Director of IT Service Management leads the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of Hertz’s global IT service management practices. This role turns technology and business priorities into reliable, measurable service operations, supporting a consistent experience for employees and business partners across the company.
  
  
Working with Technology and business leaders, the Director oversees key service management processes and the systems that support them, including ServiceNow. The role partners closely with infrastructure, end-user services, application, cybersecurity, and operations teams to improve service quality, system stability, resiliency, and compliance. It also manages team performance, budgets, and vendor relationships within the scope of responsibility, using operational data and service metrics to guide decisions and improvements.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead, develop, and motivate the IT Service Management team, setting clear goals and supporting employee growth and technical capability.
* Translate business and Technology priorities into service management plans, operational goals, and measurable outcomes .
* Develop and maintain an innovative IT Service Management roadmap that prioritizes automation and modernizes processes, tools, and service delivery in support of Hertz’s business and Technology goals.
* Lead and continuously improve service management processes, including Incident, Request, Problem, Change, Service Level, Event, Service Catalog, and Configuration Management (CMDB).
* Use KPIs, service data, and customer feedback to identify performance gaps, manage backlogs, and prioritize process and system improvements.
* Oversee the ServiceNow platform roadmap and backlog, partnering with stakeholders on enhancements, automation, integrations, and adoption.
* Work with Technology and business leaders to improve service quality, operational readiness, system stability, and resiliency.
* Manage the service management budget and assigned resources, balancing service needs, risk, and cost.
* Set expectations for vendors and service providers supporting ITSM processes; monitor service levels, delivery, governance, and cost-effectiveness.
* Ensure service management policies and procedures reflect current practices and support compliance with applicable requirements, including SOX, PCI, IT audit, GDPR, and CCPA.
* Identify relevant technology and industry developments, including ITIL 4, ServiceNow, and DevOps practices, and assess their value to Hertz.
* Communicate service performance, risks, priorities, and improvement plans clearly to executives, business partners, employees, and vendors.
* Build effective working relationships across Technology and the business to coordinate service ownership and resolve operational issues.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* ITIL 4 certification preferred; advanced degree is a plus.
* 10+ years of progressive IT experience in infrastructure, end-user services, service management, or technology operations.
* Significant people leadership experience, including leading teams and developing talent; experience managing service operations in a large, distributed enterprise preferred.
* Experience in leading or improving enterprise IT service management practices, including Incident, Problem, Change, and Configuration Management (CMDB).
* Hands-on familiarity with ITSM platforms and workflows; ServiceNow experience strongly preferred.
* Experience managing service providers or managed service providers, including performance against service levels and contractual commitments.
* Knowledge of technology operations and service delivery in a complex, multi-location environment.
* Ability to use operational data and service metrics to set priorities, improve performance, and communicate results.
* Strong communication, presentation, documentation, and relationship-building skills.
* Demonstrated ability to coach and develop teams, manage competing priorities, and lead complex improvement initiatives.
* Strong customer focus, sound judgment, and adaptability in a dynamic environment.
* Courageous leadership and accountability.

**What You’ll Get**

* Up to 40% off the base rate of any standard Hertz Rental
* Paid Time Off
* Medical, Dental & Vision plan options
* Retirement programs, including 401(k) employer matching
* Paid Parental Leave & Adoption Assistance
* Employee Assistance Program for employees & family
* Educational Reimbursement & Discounts
* Voluntary Insurance Programs - Pet, Legal/Identity Theft, Critical Illness
* Perks & Discounts –Theme Park Tickets, Gym Discounts & more

**About Us**
The Hertz Corporation operates the Hertz, Dollar Car Rental, Thrifty Car Rental brands in approximately 9,700 corporate and franchisee locations throughout North America, Europe, The Caribbean, Latin America, Africa, the Middle East, Asia, Australia and New Zealand. The Hertz Corporation is one of the largest worldwide airport general use vehicle rental companies, and the Hertz brand is one of the most recognized in the world.
  
  
**US EEO STATEMENT**
At Hertz, we champion and celebrate a culture of diversity and inclusion. We take affirmative steps to promote employment and advancement opportunities. The endless variety of perspectives, experiences, skills and talents that our employees invest in their work every day represent a significant part of our culture – and our success and reputation as a company.
  
  
Individuals are encouraged to apply for positions because of the characteristics that make them unique.

Title: INGENYX- Infrastructure and Network Manager
Description:
**Expected Travel**
: Up to 25%
  
  
**Requisition ID**
: 14759
  
  
**Ingenyx proudly launched as a new, independent company following its divestiture from Teleflex on August 3, 2026.**
Ingenyx is a leading global provider of product development and production services for medical device manufacturers. We set ourselves apart with deep expertise, decades of experience, a dedication to design for manufacturability, and extensive, in-house capabilities, which include engineering, regulatory services, material selection and formulation, prototyping, manufacturing, assembly and packaging. We deliver industry-changing innovations and next-generation solutions for extrusions; diagnostic and interventional catheters; balloons and balloon catheters; sheath/dilator sets; specialty sutures, braids and fibers; and bioabsorbable sutures, yarns and resins. Join a dynamic, growing team that offers healthcare providers an array of medical technology solutions that make a difference in patients’ lives.
  
  
For more information, please visit Ingenyx.com
  
  
**Position Summary**
Ingenyx seeks a hands-on Infrastructure & Network Manager to lead global infrastructure and networking operations, directly own core Microsoft enterprise platforms and recovery capabilities, and help safeguard a global medical device manufacturing environment. Reporting to the CIO, this leader manages two Infrastructure Engineers, establishes consistent standards across Ingenyx locations, and coordinates internal teams and external partners to resolve critical issues quickly. The role combines technical accountability, strong people leadership, vendor coordination, disciplined incident response, and proactive risk reduction.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities**
1 | Global Networking & Site Infrastructure
  
  

* Own availability, performance, configuration, and lifecycle of networks across every Ingenyx office and manufacturing site, including WAN/LAN, switches, routers, firewalls, Wi-Fi access points, cabling, hardwired ports, and remote connectivity.
* Define and enforce common infrastructure architectures, network segmentation, configuration baselines, monitoring, inventories, diagrams, and site documentation while accommodating justified local requirements.
* Lead troubleshooting and restoration of infrastructure and connectivity services, directing engineers, local personnel, carriers, and vendors; maintain clear escalation and stakeholder communications.
* Plan preventive maintenance, upgrades, capacity, resiliency, and technical refreshes to support manufacturing continuity and future expansion.

2 | Microsoft Platforms, Servers & Recovery — Direct Operational Ownership
  
  

* Own day-to-day operational health, administration, availability, and lifecycle management of Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, Windows servers, and associated hybrid infrastructure, whether work is performed internally or with service providers.
* Account for tenant and subscription configuration, identity and access controls, privileged access, authentication, group policies where applicable, service integration, licensing coordination, monitoring, patching, capacity, and platform change control.
* Own enterprise backup, restore, and disaster recovery operations: backup policy execution, job monitoring, retention and recoverability validation, periodic restore testing, recovery procedures, and remediation of identified gaps.
* Coordinate infrastructure and cloud changes with business application owners, manufacturing stakeholders, service providers, and cybersecurity partners to minimize operational disruption.

3 | Cybersecurity Operations & Incident Response
  
  

* Collaborate with external cybersecurity and managed security service providers to ensure effective security monitoring, threat detection, incident investigation, and timely remediation of identified risks and vulnerabilities across Ingenyx’s global technology environment.
* Ensure potential threats and security alerts receive timely triage, investigation, escalation, containment, remediation, and closure, with clear accountability across internal teams and external providers.
* Lead technical response for infrastructure, network, cloud, server, and identity-related security issues; perform and document root cause analysis for significant incidents and track corrective and preventive actions through completion.
* Oversee vulnerability remediation, security patching, configuration hardening, firewall rule governance, access control hygiene, and follow-up on SOC findings; report material risks and trends to the CIO.

4 | Leadership, Service Delivery & Improvement
  
  

* Lead, coach, and develop the infrastructure & networking team; assign priorities, establish performance expectations, build technical depth, and foster accountability and responsive service.
* Manage service relationships and incident collaboration with managed service providers, network carriers, infrastructure suppliers, external cybersecurity and managed security service providers, and other partners; monitor SLAs, escalations, and unresolved actions.
* Own problem management for recurring infrastructure incidents, including documented root causes, sustainable fixes, and trend analysis; maintain well-controlled changes and operational procedures.
* Partner with the CIO on infrastructure strategy, investment cases, technical roadmaps, budgets, operational reporting, disaster recovery preparedness, and continuous improvement; support applicable quality and validated-system requirements.

**Education / Experience Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience; typically 7+ years in infrastructure/network engineering or operations with demonstrated team leadership.
* Strong hands-on expertise with enterprise switching, routing, TCP/IP, VLANs, DNS/DHCP, VPNs, firewalls, wireless infrastructure, network monitoring, and structured troubleshooting.
* Proven operational experience with Azure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Windows Server, hybrid identity, backup/recovery, and enterprise systems administration.
* Experience leading major incidents, working across internal and third-party teams, documenting root cause analysis, and driving corrective actions to closure.
* Working knowledge of cybersecurity operations, vulnerabilities, access management, infrastructure hardening, security alerts, and SOC collaboration.
* Effective people leadership, vendor/SLA management, technical documentation, prioritization, and communication with both technical and business audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**
**Specialized Skills / Other Requirements**

* Global multisite manufacturing experience, preferably medical device, life sciences, or another regulated industry; understanding of shop-floor connectivity and OT segmentation.
* Experience with managed network security/SOC services; familiarity with SIEM and security monitoring platforms.
* Knowledge of GxP, validated-system change controls, ISO 13485, and business continuity practices; relevant Microsoft, Cisco, security, or infrastructure certifications.

Leadership Competencies & Success Measures
  
  
Success requires ownership, sound technical judgment, calm incident leadership, people development, cross-functional influence, transparent communication, a security-first mindset, and continuous improvement. Performance is measured by site/network and platform availability; incident response and recovery; Microsoft service reliability; backup and restore test results; vulnerability and security-alert remediation timeliness; documented root cause and corrective action completion; site standardization; partner SLA performance; and team effectiveness.
  
  
Position Impact
  
  
This role ensures Ingenyx has a dependable, consistent, and secure infrastructure foundation that protects business operations, supports global manufacturing, and enables continued growth. Operational accountability remains with this manager even where implementation or monitoring is provided by external partners.
  
  
The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between $132,900-$166,00, however, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position will also include benefits such as medical, prescription drug, dental and vision insurance, flexible spending accounts, participation in 401(k) savings plan, and various paid time off benefits, such as PTO, short- and long-term disability and parental leave, dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.
  
  
If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

Applicants will be considered without regard to age, race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, sexual orientation, disability, nationality, sex, or veteran status. If you require accommodation to apply for a position, please contact us at: 877-880-8588 or Talent@Teleflex.com.*

Title: Head of Service Delivery
Description:
**Head of Delivery – Global Organization**

Are you a senior leader with a unique mix of commercial acumen, operational expertise, and a proven ability to inspire high-performing teams? Do you thrive in dynamic, fast-paced environments, where your decisions directly impact the business? If so, Influx wants to hear from you.

Influx is seeking a visionary and results-driven
**Head of Delivery**
to oversee and elevate our service delivery function for the mid-market segment, the most dynamic part of our business. Your role will be to ensure our client partnerships are successful, our operations are exceptional, and our teams are empowered to deliver their best.

As Head of Delivery, you’ll lead a global team of Delivery Directors, ensuring excellence in service delivery, proactive client engagement, and long-term commercial growth.

**Core responsibilities:**

* **Service Excellence:**
  Lead delivery operations to meet and exceed client expectations. Oversee the performance of Delivery units, ensuring every account runs like clockwork.
* **Client Partnerships:**
  Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, acting as a strategic partner and escalation point.
* **Client Success & Product Leadership:**
  Develop and execute strategies to hit revenue, retention, and margin targets. Collaborate across teams to identify and seize growth opportunities.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Implement cutting-edge delivery practices, leveraging data and analytics to drive efficiencies and innovations.
* **Leadership:**
  Shape a high-performing team culture, mentor emerging leaders, and design an organizational structure fit for sustainable growth.

Title: Incident Operations Manager
Description:
**About This Role**
At Chime, we help our members achieve financial peace of mind. To do this we need features that are highly available and human & technical systems that are resilient. That’s where you come in. You will be a member of our Incident Response team to help Chime improve our readiness, response and drive organizational change from incidents.
  
  
As an Incident Operations Manager on Chime's Incident Operations team (Platform Engineering), you'll manage incidents end to end: from declaration and coordination, through member communication and member remediation, to review and follow-through. You'll work across Engineering, Product, Member Experience (MX), Core Experience, Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Finance, and lead through influence rather than authority. You'll bring a proactive, solution-oriented mindset and keep the member at the center of every decision. Alongside on-call work, you'll own defined improvement workstreams that make our response better every quarter.
  
  
**In This Role, You Can Expect To**

* Coordinate incidents end to end. Serve on the incident on-call rotation, including some after-hours coverage on weekends, nights, and holidays. Independently run incidents from declaration to resolution: setting severity, paging the right responders, running the bridge, confirming member impact, and driving mitigation decisions.
* Help drive communication during incidents. Draft clear, accurate member messages across in-app, push, inbox, email, and support channels; move them through Compliance and Legal approval within severity-based timelines; and keep Support and MX teams equipped with talking points.
* Drive member remediation to closure. Run the Remediating phase: define workstreams, DRIs, and exit criteria; partner with Data to size the impacted population; coordinate credits and bulk adjustments with Finance, Compliance, and Core Experience
* Keep stakeholders informed. Deliver timely status reports and sitreps for leadership, and supply impact summaries and timelines that Compliance and Legal use for bank partner and regulatory notifications.
* Close the loop. Facilitate incident reviews for the incidents you manage, capture learnings, and make sure corrective actions have owners and due dates.
* Get ahead of problems. Spot risks and gaps before they become incidents or repeat incidents, raise them early, and come up with a proposed solution.
* Improve how we respond. Own at least one program workstream, such as pre-approved member message templates, runbooks, or response metrics, and ship measurable improvements.
* Cross-train and share knowledge. Build working fluency on both the technical-command and member-impact sides of an incident, and help train coordinators and responders.

**To thrive in this role, you have**

* 3+ years in incident management, or a similar operational role, including hands-on coordination of live, customer-impacting incidents.
* A strong member focus. You think first about how an incident affects real people and their money, and you measure success by whether members are informed and made whole, not just whether systems are restored.
* A proactive, solution-oriented approach. You act before being asked, look for the next risk instead of waiting for it, and bring options and recommendations.
* Experience managing the customer side of an incident: writing customer-facing communications, working with support teams, and coordinating remediation.
* Calm, structured judgment under pressure; you know when to decide, when to escalate, and when to ask for help.
* Enough technical fluency to follow engineers through an investigation and ask good questions (observability, deploys, dependencies, distributed systems).
* Experience with incident and observability tools such as PagerDuty, incident.io, Datadog, Slack-based incident tooling, Jira, and Google Workspace.
* Clear, concise writing for different audiences: members, technical SMEs, compliance partners, and executives.
* Strong follow-through; you drive action items and remediation work to closure without being chased.

**Nice to have**

* Experience in fintech, banking, payments, or another regulated industry.

For commissioned roles, the base salary listed in this job description does not include incentive/variable pay. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

Because if we don't—who will?

Title: Major Incident IT Manager, Temporary
Description:
**WHY UT SOUTHWESTERN?**
  
With over 75 years of excellence in Dallas-Fort Worth, Texas, UT Southwestern is committed to excellence, innovation, teamwork, and compassion. As a world-renowned medical and research center, we strive to provide the best possible care, resources, and benefits for our valued employees. Ranked as the No. 1 hospital in Dallas-Fort Worth according to *U.S. News & World Report*, we invest in you with opportunities for career growth and development to align with your future goals. Our highly competitive benefits package offers healthcare, PTO and paid holidays, on-site childcare, wage, merit increases and so much more. We invite you to be a part of the UT Southwestern team where you’ll discover a culture of teamwork, professionalism, and a rewarding career!

**JOB SUMMARY**
  
**This is a 6-month to 1-year temporary position with an opportunity to move to a permanent role depending on performance.**
  
The Major Incident Manager coordinates and manages responses to major IT incidents to minimize business disruption and restore services as quickly as possible. This role serves as the central coordination point throughout the major incident lifecycle, facilitating cross-functional collaboration, managing escalations, coordinating technical teams, and ensuring timely stakeholder communications. Working within established ITIL practices, the position partners with the Incident Management Process Owner, ITSM team, technical resolver groups, Service Desk, Communications Managers, Problem Management, and IT and Hospital leadership. Responsibilities also include supporting Post-Incident Reviews (PIRs), collaborating on Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and tracking follow-up actions. This is a hands-on operational role requiring occasional overnight, weekend, and holiday availability to support major incident response.

**BENEFITS**
  
UT Southwestern is proud to offer a competitive and comprehensive benefits package to eligible employees. Our benefits are designed to support your overall wellbeing, and include:

* PPO medical plan, available day one at no cost for full-time employee-only coverage
* 100% coverage for preventive healthcare-no copay
* Paid Time Off, available day one
* Retirement Programs through the Teacher Retirement System of Texas (TRS)
* Paid Parental Leave Benefit
* Wellness programs
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) Qualified Employer
  

**Required Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Required Experience**

* **Five or more years of experience in IT Service Management, Incident Management, IT Operations, or a related IT service delivery function.**
* **A minimum of 5 year’s experience as a Major Incident Manager with experience coordinating and leading high-impact incidents, escalations, or cross-functional IT operational activities.**
* Working knowledge of Incident Management and Major Incident Management practices.
* Experience using ServiceNow ITSM, including Incident Management and related workflows.
* Strong understanding of incident prioritization, impact assessment, escalation procedures, and service restoration activities.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple technical teams and stakeholders during time-sensitive situations.
Experience with Post-Incident Reviews, Problem Management, and Root Cause Analysis is preferred.  

**Preffered Experience**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical information to non-technical audiences and leadership.
* Strong facilitation, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to remain composed, exercise sound judgment, and manage competing priorities in high-pressure situations.
* Demonstrated accountability, attention to detail, and ability to maintain accurate incident documentation and timelines.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across organizational boundaries.
ITIL 4 Foundation certification preferred; ITIL v5 certification or relevant ITSM training is a plus.  

**Work Schedule & Availability**
  
This is a temporary to permanent, full-time position. While the position will generally operate during standard business hours, overnight, weekend, and holiday work will be required periodically to support major incident response, service restoration, and operational coverage. Flexibility and availability outside of normal business hours are essential requirements of this position.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**
  
**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate the end-to-end lifecycle of major incidents, from identification and declaration through service restoration and closure.
* Assess incident impact and urgency, validate escalation criteria, and facilitate appropriate major incident designation.
* Serve as the central coordination point for major incident response activities across technical teams and business stakeholders.
* Initiate, facilitate, and manage major incident bridges, ensuring appropriate participation, structure, and progress.
* Coordinate technical resolver groups, monitor investigation activities, track action items, and identify barriers to resolution.
* Facilitate prioritization, escalation, and resource coordination to support timely service restoration.
* Ensure incident records, timelines, decisions, actions, and status updates are accurately maintained in ServiceNow.
* Coordinate timely and consistent communications with IT leadership, business stakeholders, affected departments, and other impacted audiences.
* Partner with Major Incident Process Owner and Communications Managers to ensure communications are accurate, appropriate, and delivered according to established standards.
* Monitor incident progress and provide status updates, escalation notifications, and executive summaries as appropriate.
* Ensure appropriate handoffs between Major Incident Management, Incident Management, and Problem Management.
* Participate in and facilitate post-incident reviews (PIRs), documenting lessons learned, response effectiveness, and improvement opportunities.
* Collaborate with the Problem Manager on root cause analysis (RCA), corrective actions, and follow-up activities.
* Ensure outstanding action items and follow-up activities are documented, assigned, and tracked through completion.
* Maintain adherence to established ITIL practices, operational procedures, escalation guidelines, and communication standards.
* Support continual improvement by identifying recurring challenges, process gaps, and opportunities to improve major incident response.
* Provide operational support outside of standard business hours, including overnight, weekends, and holidays as required.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

* Work requires ability to ensure adherence to all policies and procedures of university.

* Work requires ability to effectively interpret and apply organizational policies, procedures, and systems.

* Work requires demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and exercise decision-making and problem-solving skills.

By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Digital & Tech Command Centre operates 24x7x365 to protect GSK’s critical sites, applications and services. Disruption or degradation to these directly impacts patient supply, research and colleague productivity.
  
  
This role owns and leads the end-to-end response to Major Incidents (P1) and managed high-priority (P2) incidents. In collaboration with AI-enabled monitoring, detection and triage capabilities, the role directs resolver
  
  
teams and subject matter experts from across Tech towards the fastest possible restoration of service, while providing accurate, timely and audience-appropriate communication to end users, senior stakeholders and
  
  
executive leadership. The role also assesses incidents for crisis potential, secures the quality of the incident record for downstream Problem Management, and drives continuous improvement in prevention, detection and response - including the adoption of AI and automation to shorten time to detect, time to engage and time to restore. As a more experienced member of the Major Incident Manager team, the role additionally acts as an escalation point within the team, to support less experienced colleagues, as well as to field senior stakeholders’ questions and requests for information. Additionally, the role supports management of the shift rota, supports the personal
  
  
development of Major Incident Managers through structured feedback and mentoring and leads service-related objectives such as Continual Service Improvement (CSI) initiatives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:
  
  
**Major Incident Response & Command**

* Own the end-to-end management of Major Incidents (P1) and managed high-priority (P2) incidents, from detection through to confirmed service restoration, acting as the single point of control for the duration of the incident.
* Rapidly establish impact, urgency and scope, confirm correct prioritisation, and drive immediate engagement of the right resolver teams, subject matter experts and vendors.
* Lead technical bridges with authority, keeping activity focused on restoration, controlling scope, and ensuring hypotheses are tested and eliminated systematically.
